# tenure standpoint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureStandpoint`](gmeow-tenureStandpoint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureStandpoint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)

The standpoint whose position a standpoint-tenure records. When a [`StandpointTenure`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) generates a [`StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) observation, the [`tenureStandpoint`](gmeow-tenureStandpoint.md) becomes the vantage of the claim.
